nodes.description: Privileged owner address; controls administrative functions via onlyOwner modifier.
Bankroll address that receives dividends and is exempt from the spin path.
Tracked ZTH token balance held by the contract; mutated on wins/losses.
Boolean public switch that gates betting via the gameIsActive modifier and require(gameActive).
Mapping of address to pending playerSpin struct; written after external token transfer in _finishSpin.
Mapping of allowed wager token amounts used to validate spins.
Initializes owner, bankroll, token interface, approvals, valid bet amounts and gameActive.
Public ZTHReceivingContract hook that routes incoming tokens to _spinTokens or credits contractBalance for the bankroll.
Private validation and registration of a spin wager; writes playerSpins, totalSpins and totalZTHWagered.
Private payout logic that derives a result, computes profit, sends tokens to the winner and resets the spin struct.
Public wrapper that finishes the caller's pending spin via _finishSpin.
View helper ensuring 500x max profit does not exceed 90% of contractBalance.
Internal helper computing a modulo over the maxRandom hash.
View pseudo-random generator based on blockhash of a past/guessed block, contract address and entropy.
Administrative function that reassigns the owner address; guarded by onlyOwner.
Administrative function that sets gameActive to false; guarded by onlyOwner.
Administrative function that sets gameActive to true; guarded by onlyOwner.
Administrative function that adds an allowed wager amount; guarded by onlyOwner.
Administrative function that reassigns the bankroll address; guarded by onlyOwner.
Administrative function that forwards the whole Ether balance to the bankroll address.
Caller-controlled address used pervasively for authorization, spin ownership and payouts.
External token transfer to the winner performed before playerSpins is reset, enabling reentrancy.
External Ether transfer of address(this).balance to the bankroll address.
Pseudo-randomness derived from blockhash of a prior block, manipulable/influenced by block producers.
Multiplier and division arithmetic computing profit and balance deltas (mul/div/sub/add).
Sender address parameter of tokenFallback; selects bankroll credit vs. spin path.
Token amount parameter of tokenFallback; used as the wager value.
Address parameter of _finishSpin; the player whose pending spin is settled.
Wager parameter of jackpotGuard used to compute the maximum possible profit.
New owner address parameter of changeOwner.
Local payout amount computed by the multiplier branches in _finishSpin.
Local random result value driving payout category selection in _finishSpin.
Local playerSpin struct copy (tokenValue, blockn) read/written in _finishSpin.

edges.reason: Constructor derives owner from msg.sender, anchoring all later authorization.
tokenFallback passes msg.sender into the ZTH-token origin check.
_spinTokens requires _zthToken(msg.sender) so the caller address gates the spin path.
finishSpin forwards msg.sender as the spin target to _finishSpin.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in changeOwner.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in pauseGame.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in resumeGame.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in addNewBetAmount.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in changeBankroll.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner in divertDividendsToBankroll.
tokenFallback invokes _spinTokens for non-bankroll senders.
tokenFallback credits contractBalance when tokens arrive from the bankroll.
_spinTokens settles a previously pending spin through _finishSpin.
_spinTokens requires jackpotGuard(_tkn.value) before accepting a wager.
_spinTokens reads and writes playerSpins[msg.sender] with the new wager and block.
_spinTokens requires validTokenBet[_tkn.value] to be true.
_spinTokens requires gameActive, a privileged game-state flag.
finishSpin delegates settlement to _finishSpin.
_finishSpin calls random() to derive the payout result.
random() delegates to maxRandom for the underlying hash.
maxRandom relies on blockhash(blockn) pseudo-randomness that miners can influence.
_finishSpin computes profit with multiply/divide and adjusts balances with add/sub.
_finishSpin calls the external token transfer before resetting playerSpins[target].
The external token transfer can re-enter and interact with the still-populated playerSpins entry.
_finishSpin adds losses to or subtracts winnings from contractBalance.
jackpotGuard evaluates 90% of contractBalance.
jackpotGuard multiplies the wager by 500 and scales contractBalance arithmetically.
divertDividendsToBankroll performs an external Ether transfer to the bankroll address.
changeOwner overwrites the privileged owner state variable.
changeBankroll overwrites the privileged bankroll state variable.
pauseGame flips the gameActive flag to false.
resumeGame flips the gameActive flag to true.
addNewBetAmount whitelists a new token bet amount in validTokenBet.
Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
Constructor assigns bankroll from the supplied bankroll address.
Constructor seeds the initial allowed wager amounts.
Constructor enables the game by setting gameActive to true.
